patterns.name: Euler Finance Donation Attack
patterns.code_signature: ERC4626-style vault with direct ERC20 transfer affecting share-price math; missing virtual-share offset.
patterns.recommended_fix: Inherit OpenZeppelin ERC4626 v4.7+ with _decimalsOffset, or mint a dead-share floor in the constructor.

patterns.name: Nomad Bridge Replay
patterns.code_signature: initialize() sets a sentinel value treated as 'already trusted' for any subsequent caller.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use OpenZeppelin `initializer` modifier; never trust sentinel/zero values; validate the trusted-root commit explicitly.

patterns.name: Wormhole Signature Verification
patterns.code_signature: Bridge core used a deprecated signature-verification function that returned true on default inputs.
patterns.recommended_fix: Pin to a non-deprecated signature primitive; assert non-zero recovered address; fuzz the verifier.

patterns.name: Ronin Bridge Validator Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Bridge required 5-of-9 validators; 4 keys controlled by a single party + one phished key compromised the threshold.
patterns.recommended_fix: Increase threshold (≥7-of-9), enforce independent custody, and audit the operational footprint of each signer.

patterns.name: KelpDAO LayerZero DVN Drain
patterns.code_signature: LayerZero endpoint configured with a 1-of-N DVN verifier set; single operator key compromise enabled forged inbound messages.
patterns.recommended_fix: Require N≥3 distinct DVN operators with independent infrastructure and audited operational separation.

patterns.name: Multichain MPC Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Cross-chain bridge custody concentrated in MPC keys held by a single individual; opaque off-chain key management.
patterns.recommended_fix: On-chain validator set with independent custody; rotate keys; publish proof-of-reserves.

patterns.name: Curve Vyper Reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Vyper 0.2.15/0.2.16/0.3.0 mis-emitted `@nonreentrant` decorator; pools could re-enter via plain ETH receive.
patterns.recommended_fix: Upgrade Vyper compiler; audit any contract relying on @nonreentrant on the affected versions; prefer explicit Solidity-style mutex.

patterns.name: Mango Markets Oracle Manipulation
patterns.code_signature: On-chain perpetuals priced collateral via a thin spot oracle; attacker pumped the spot, borrowed, then dumped.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use TWAP or a multi-oracle median; circuit-breakers on rapid price moves; require minimum oracle liquidity depth.

patterns.name: bZx Flash Loan
patterns.code_signature: Lending market accepted a Uniswap V1 spot reading as oracle inside an atomic borrow; flash loan pushed price atomically.
patterns.recommended_fix: Block oracle reads within the same atomic context as a price-impacting trade; use TWAP.

patterns.name: Cream Finance Re-Pricing
patterns.code_signature: yUSD share price treated as price input to collateral; attacker doubled share value, drained collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Never treat unbounded share-price as a price feed; protect vault share-price with donation guards.

patterns.name: Beanstalk Governance Flashloan
patterns.code_signature: Governance executed proposals after a same-block flashloaned stake-weighted vote.
patterns.recommended_fix: Require voting delay (snapshot of stake at proposal creation, not vote time) + post-pass timelock.

patterns.name: Radiant Capital LayerZero Drain
patterns.code_signature: Compromised multisig signers executed a malicious transaction through LayerZero proxy admin path.
patterns.recommended_fix: Hardware-key custody for all signers; simulation gating on every multisig tx; rotate signers after every breach signal.

patterns.name: KyberSwap Elastic Tick Rounding
patterns.code_signature: Concentrated-liquidity math rounded ticks such that a crafted swap moved across a boundary without paying the LP fee.
patterns.recommended_fix: Audit tick-cross math, add invariants on liquidity-delta application, integrate fuzzing on swap pathways.

patterns.name: Harvest Finance Flashloan
patterns.code_signature: Yield strategy priced underlying via Curve spot during deposit/withdraw inside the same flash loan.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use TWAP, separate deposit/withdraw price snapshots, withdrawal fee buffer.

patterns.name: Poly Network Cross-Chain Manager
patterns.code_signature: Cross-chain manager function selector collided; attacker called a privileged setter through the public bridge entrypoint.
patterns.recommended_fix: Strictly check msg.sender against an allowlist; avoid selectors that overlap public entrypoints; audit calldata routing.

patterns.name: Rari Fuse Reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Compound-fork market allowed re-entrancy via ERC777 `_callTokensReceived` hook during borrow.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply reentrancy guards across the borrow/redeem path; reject ERC777 collateral or wrap.
